title: English learning
description: A personal English tutor team: a tutor for daily conversation and lessons, a curriculum planner and a quiz maker. They learn your level and goals from the library, keep a progress log in the project folder and can remind you in chat.
audience: Someone learning English on their own.

resources.title: Learner profile
resources.description: Who the learner is: level, goals, interests, available time, native language, known weak spots. English agents read this first. FILL IT IN.

resources.title: Trusted English resources
resources.description: Websites, channels and books the agents should use and recommend (and which to avoid). Edit the list to your taste.

schedules.name: English — daily lesson
schedules.text: Run today's English lesson for me. First read my learner profile and the progress log, then give me a short (10–15 minute) lesson with 3–5 interactive steps and wait for my answers.

schedules.name: English — weekly review
schedules.text: Do my weekly English review: read the progress log, summarise what improved and what keeps going wrong, and propose next week's focus and a small plan.

after: 1) Open 📚 Resources → "Learner profile" and fill it in (level, goals, time, native language). 2) Open Settings → Schedules, pick the chat for the two prepared schedules and turn them on. 3) Start with a task for english-tutor: "Assess my level with a short chat".
